122  def get_trajectory(self, name):
123  """
124  Get trajectory from trajectories manager and return a JointTrajectory
125 
126  :param name: pose name
127  :type name: str
128  :return: The trajectory object
129  :rtype: JointTrajectory
130  """
131  corrected = False
132  traj_read = self.traj_file_manager.read(str(name))
133  list_poses_raw = traj_read.list_poses
134  if len(list_poses_raw) > 1:
135  for i in range(len(list_poses_raw)):
136  list_poses_raw[i], is_corrected = self.__limit_params_joints(list_poses_raw[i])
137  corrected = corrected or is_corrected
138  return JointTrajectory(
139  header=Header(stamp=rospy.Time.now()),
140  joint_names=rospy.get_param("~joint_names"),
141  points=[
142  JointTrajectoryPoint(positions=pose_raw) for pose_raw in list_poses_raw
143  ],
144  ), corrected

195  def record(self):
196  if self.__lock.acquire(False):
197  try:
198  self.__recording = True
199  self.__learning_trajectory_publisher.publish(True)
200  self.__arm_state.force_learning_mode(True)
201 
202  trajectory = JointTrajectory(
203  header=Header(),
204  joint_names=rospy.get_param("~joint_names"),
205  points=[],
206  )
207  time_ref = rospy.Time.now()
208  while not rospy.is_shutdown() and self.__recording:
209  trajectory.points.append(
210  JointTrajectoryPoint(
211  time_from_start=rospy.Time.now() - time_ref,
212  positions=self.__arm_state.joint_states,
213  ))
214  self.__frequency.sleep()
215  self.__recording = False
216  self.__learning_trajectory_publisher.publish(False)
217  self.__arm_state.force_learning_mode(False)
218  finally:
219  self.__lock.release()
220  else:
221  return
222 
223  if len(trajectory.points) > 1:
224  self.save_trajectory(trajectory)
225  self.blockly_save_trajectory()
226  try:
227  result, _ = self.get_trajectory("last_executed_trajectory")
228  if EXECUTE_AFTER_LEARNED:
229  self.__traj_executor.execute_joint_trajectory(result)
230  except Exception:
231  rospy.logwarn("TrajectoryHandlerNode::record - Wrong trajectory format")
232  else:
233  print("Not enough points to create Trajectory")

238  def __limit_params_joints(self, joints):
239  limit_corrected = False
240  joints_limits = self.__parameters_validator.get_joints_limits()
241  for j, joint_value in enumerate(joints):
242  joint = max(joints_limits[j].lower, min(joints_limits[j].upper, joint_value))
243  if joint != joint_value:
244  limit_corrected = True
245  joints[j] = joint
246  return joints, limit_corrected

250  def __callback_manage_trajectory(self, req):
251  cmd = req.cmd
252  if cmd == req.SAVE_LAST_LEARNED:
253  try:
254  if not self.check_trajectory_existence("last_executed_trajectory"):
255  return (
256  CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_RENAME_FAILURE,
257  "No trajectory to save on hold",
258  )
259 
260  status = self.update_trajectory("last_executed_trajectory", req.description, req.name)
261  if status:
262  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Created trajectory '{}'".format(req.name)
263  else:
264  return (
265  CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_RENAME_FAILURE,
266  "A trajectory is already saved with this name",
267  )
268  except NiryoRobotFileException as e:
269  return CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_RENAME_FAILURE, str(e)
270  elif cmd == req.SAVE:
271  try:
272  # We receive tuples because of message serialization, so we reconvert them to lists
273  for point in req.trajectory.points:
274  point.positions = list(point.positions)
275  _status = self.save_trajectory(req.trajectory, req.name, req.description)
276  if _status:
277  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Saved trajectory '{}'".format(req.name)
278  else:
279  return (
280  CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_CREATION_FAILED,
281  "Name already taken",
282  )
283  except NiryoRobotFileException as e:
284  return CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_CREATION_FAILED, str(e)
285  elif cmd == req.DELETE:
286  try:
287  self.remove_trajectory_file(req.name)
288  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Removed trajectory '{}'".format(req.name)
289  except NiryoRobotFileException as e:
290  return CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_REMOVAL_FAILED, str(e)
291  elif cmd == req.DELETE_ALL:
292  try:
293  trajectory_name_list, description_list = (self.get_available_trajectories_w_description())
294  for trajectory in trajectory_name_list:
295  self.remove_trajectory_file(trajectory)
296  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Removed All Trajectories "
297  except NiryoRobotFileException as e:
298  return CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_REMOVAL_FAILED, str(e)
299  elif cmd == req.UPDATE:
300  try:
301  status = self.update_trajectory(req.name, req.description, req.new_name)
302  if status:
303  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Updated Trajectory '{}'".format(req.name)
304  else:
305  return (
306  CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_RENAME_FAILURE,
307  "Name already taken, Update Failed",
308  )
309  except NiryoRobotFileException as e:
310  return CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_RENAME_FAILURE, str(e)
311  elif cmd == req.EXECUTE_REGISTERED:
312  try:
313  if self.check_trajectory_existence(req.name):
314  trajectory, _ = self.get_trajectory(req.name)
315  self.__parameters_validator.validate_trajectory(trajectory)
316  return self.__traj_executor.execute_joint_trajectory(trajectory)
317  else:
318  return (
319  CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_EXECUTE_REGISTERED_FAILURE,
320  str(NiryoRobotFileException),
321  )
322  except ArmCommanderException as e:
323  return CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_EXECUTE_REGISTERED_FAILURE, str(e)
324  elif cmd == req.EXECUTE:
325  try:
326  return self.__traj_executor.execute_joint_trajectory(req.trajectory)
327  except ArmCommanderException as e:
328  return CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_EXECUTE_FAILURE, str(e)
329  elif cmd == req.GO_TO_FIRST_POINT:
330  try:
331  trajectory, _ = self.get_trajectory(req.name)
332  trajectory.points = [trajectory.points[0]]
333  return self.__traj_executor.execute_joint_trajectory(trajectory)
334  except ArmCommanderException as e:
335  return CommandStatus.TRAJECTORY_HANDLER_EXECUTE_FAILURE, str(e)
336  else:
337  return CommandStatus.UNKNOWN_COMMAND, "cmd '{}' not found.".format(req.cmd)

367  def __callback_save_pos_button_status(self, msg):
368  if msg.action == EEButtonStatus.NO_ACTION:
369  self.stop_record()
370 
371  elif msg.action == EEButtonStatus.LONG_PUSH_ACTION and not self.__recording:
372  if not self.__record_thread.is_alive():
373  self.__record_thread = Thread(target=self.record)
374  self.__record_thread.start()
